Latest Innovations in EV Charging: How Shaffer Construction is Leading the Way in Los Angeles

Exciting Developments in EV Charging Infrastructure

As the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) accelerates, the need for reliable and widespread EV charging infrastructure becomes increasingly paramount. At Shaffer Construction, Inc., located in Los Angeles, CA, we specialize in installing EV chargers and their associated infrastructure. In this blog post, we cover the latest advancements and provide valuable insights from credible sources.

Federal Grants Boost Regional EV Charging Stations

Several cities in Northwest Oregon, including Tualatin and Tigard, recently received $15 million in federal grant funding to install hundreds of new electric vehicle chargers across the region. This ambitious project aims to make EV charging more accessible and convenient for residents and travelers alike. By expanding the EV charging infrastructure, these cities are setting a precedent for other regions to follow.

For more details, you can read the full article on Tigard Life.

Certification of 400-kW Fast Electric Vehicle Charger

Alpitronic’s HYC400 has become the first 400-kW fast electric vehicle charger to achieve UL certification from UL Solutions in Europe. This certification is significant as it sets a standard for DC charging equipment for electric vehicles, demonstrating that the charger meets rigorous safety and performance criteria. Such advancements in charger technology promise faster and more efficient charging solutions for EV owners.

For further information, refer to the full story on NGT News.

Economic Benefits of EV Chargers for Nearby Businesses

A recent study has shown that businesses located near EV chargers are experiencing increased revenue due to the influx of customers looking for something to do while their cars charge. This finding highlights an additional advantage of investing in EV infrastructure, not only supporting sustainable transportation but also boosting local economies.

To learn more about this economic impact, check out the article on InsideEVs.com/news/734705/ev-chargers-cash-cow-nearby/).

Managed EV Charging to Protect Distribution Grid

As more individuals switch to electric vehicles, the stress on the aging distribution infrastructure poses a significant challenge. Managed EV charging presents a proactive solution by optimizing charging times and loads to prevent overloading the grid. This strategy not only helps in maintaining grid stability but also maximizes the efficiency of EV chargers.

For an in-depth understanding, you can download the related eBook from Charged EVs.

Accessibility of EV Charging Stations

The Access Board is calling for enhanced accessibility to EV charging stations. This proposal emphasizes the need for physical and communication access, along with accessible charging spaces, access aisles, and routes. Ensuring that EV charging stations are accessible to individuals with disabilities is crucial for promoting inclusiveness in the adoption of electric vehicles.

For more insights on this proposal, visit the article on Facilitiesnet.com/ada/tip/Access-Board-Seeks-Accessibility-to-Electric-Vehicle-Charging-Stations--54179).
